text: A downhill mountain biker rips through a muddy forest switchback, roost spraying, low golden evening light, tight tracking shot panning with the rider on a long lens
Rally car slides sideways on a gravel stage kicking up dust, overcast grey sky, pine trees blurred behind, chase camera mounted low following the drift
Sprinters explode off the blocks on a wet blue running track under stadium floodlights, water droplets flung, head-on dolly pulling back fast
A pack of road cyclists leans into a sunlit cobbled corner, bright team lycra, warm midday haze, overhead crane sweeping across the peloton
Skateboarder flips down a concrete stair set at dusk, sparks of chalky grind dust, neon shop signs glowing, whip pan following the board
Stampede of wildebeest crosses a dusty savanna river at golden hour, brown water churning, low wide tracking shot running alongside the herd
Motocross riders launch off a dirt jump against a hard blue sky, clay clods flying, backlit sun flare, locked telephoto freezing them midair
Surfer drops down the face of a grey storm wave, spray torn off the crest by wind, cold flat light, water-housing camera tracking the bottom turn
A subway crowd surges through turnstiles at rush hour, fluorescent tube light, steel and tile surfaces, handheld shot pushing against the flow
Horses thunder down the home straight of a muddy racetrack, jockeys in silk, clods of turf flung, side-on pan matching their gallop

Sheep flood down a narrow stone-walled lane in misty highlands, grey morning fog, wet cobbles, low tracking shot weaving through the flock
A goalkeeper dives across the mouth of the goal in driving rain, floodlit stadium, grass and water flung up, slow side pan freezing the save
Street luge rider screams down a steep sunlit asphalt hill, palm shadows flickering across the road, strapped-on low chase cam

Cattle stampede through a dusty frontier town street, timber facades, hard afternoon sun, low chase cam driving ahead of the herd
